Automatically chooses Songsterr's free **continue with sync pauses** action. Normal sync pauses remain. No Plus unlock, CSS hiding, extra permissions, or runtime dependencies.

Download the extension ZIP below, extract it, then select that folder using **Load unpacked** in `brave://extensions` or `chrome://extensions` with Developer mode enabled. Reload open Songsterr tabs.

Updating an existing installation: replace its files, click **Reload** on the extension card, then reload the Songsterr tab.

Fixes continuation blocked by a stale entry-animation class on redesigned dialogs. Includes a custom extension icon and a README download button. Detection requires the observed English dialog copy. Site redesigns or localization may require an update. Zero visible flicker is not guaranteed.

Browser validation details and remaining limitations: [engineering report](https://github.com/Majkey25/songsterr-auto-continue/blob/main/docs/engineering.md).
